summary: QA162 narrow verification of the QA161 follow-ups. ALL PASS. (1) Backend: test_iter161_owner_pin_reset_isolated.py 11/11 pass (foreground, -n0, isolated DB). Updated payload test prints DEVANAGARI_PHONE_STATUS 422 and the version is unchanged. New supplementary test_iter162_owner_pin_phone_ascii.py 3/3 pass. It checks Devanagari, Arabic-Indic, fullwidth and Bengali digits, each as full, +91-prefixed, partially mixed and last-digit-only phones: all give 422 with no mutation (pin_version 1, no pin_reset_by), and no new PIN, 'input' or pin_hash appears in the error. ASCII 0x, 91x, +91x, '+91 xxxxx xxxxx' and bare formats reset sequentially v1->v6, all on the same student_id. Legacy v0 profile resets with expected 0 to v1. (2) Device check, signed in via the isolated bridge at 390x844 on the real PYQ set page (jee-main-pyq-2025-01-22-s1), with preflight/start POSTs mocked in the browser so no real attempt was created. Check OK without consent: Start disabled. OK plus consent: Start enabled. Recheck: Start disabled immediately and the button shows 'Checking…'. Recheck failure: Start disabled, success text removed, button back to 'Click here', and the error is INSIDE preflight-check-box. Retry OK: Start enabled again. Start failure (mock 409): the error shows OUTSIDE the box, check state is kept, 1 start POST. pyq-preflight-progress is 13px (same as the description) and inside the box. (3) Owner dialog on the real isolated bridge (synthetic owner/students; real auth, real CAS reset). At 390: left/right margin 16px, width 358. At 1920: width 512, no horizontal overflow at either size. Max-height is calc(100dvh-32px) with overflow auto: at 390x420 the dialog spans 16-404 with scrollHeight 488 > clientHeight 386 and Submit is reachable. Cancel, Submit and close X are all 44px. Focus starts on the new-PIN field; the phone field is readOnly; non-digits are filtered. Mismatch shows 'PINs must match.' with 0 POSTs. Cancel clears values. Success closes the dialog, shows the toast and refetches. Opening the next dialog right after a success toast dismisses the toast (0 toasts, title hit-test = dialog). Busy state shows 'Resetting…', Cancel is disabled and Escape is blocked. A stale 409 shows 'Refresh the student list…' (PIN not leaked); after reload the retry succeeds. Legacy v0 resets from the UI. New PINs log in (200) and the old PIN gives 401. Bridge DB dropped (DROPPED True) and creds file deleted. (4) Home cards, guest / and signed-in /home at 1920x800 and 390x844: 4 surfaces (series banner + JEE Main/BITSAT/COMEDK). Title, icon and blank points hit-test to the whole-card link. Each exam card has exactly 1 hub anchor, and the H2 is not inside a link. get_by_role heading names 'JEE Main'/'BITSAT'/'COMEDK' each count 1. Coordinate clicks on title, icon and blank navigate to the hub (signed in) or to /login?next=<hub> (guest; ExamHub is Protected by design). Explore, Chapter practice and My results are not intercepted (hit-test ok), with heights 51/44/44. The live badge is 44px. Tab order is whole-card -> mocks -> chapters -> results -> next card. Enter on the whole-card navigates. Ctrl+click opens a new tab and the original page stays. No overflow. The legacy testid exam-home-title-link-<slug> is kept on the H2.

critical_code_review_comments: request_contracts.py OwnerPinResetPayload: the pattern ^[+0-9 ()-]+$ is ASCII-only in pydantic-core's Rust regex, as verified with 4 Unicode digit scripts. Good.

SetDetail.check(): setChecked(false) before the async preflight correctly drops Start during a recheck. The ErrorBox is conditionally placed on 'checked', so a start error stays outside the box and a check error inside it. Good.
OwnerPinReset.toggle: toast.dismiss() only on open. A toast fired while the dialog is open (none in the current flows, since errors go to the ErrorBox) could still overlap. Acceptable.
seed_data_creation: None persistent. Only the random isolated DBs tejas_isolated_iter161_<hex> (pytest + bridge), both dropped. No customer data or credentials were used; preflight/start were mocked in the browser.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the iter161/162 suites with -n0 (pytest.ini adds xdist), each file in its own process. test_iter162 imports the 'isolated' fixture and helpers from the iter161 module. Bridge: python iso_bridge_iter161.py on 127.0.0.1:8796. In Playwright, proxy BASE/api/** to the bridge with httpx and a manual cookie jar (SimpleCookie). For a signed-in SetDetail, route only /api/auth/* to the bridge, map /api/my/sets/{id} to the real public /api/sets/{id}, and mock the preflight/start POSTs. Stop the bridge with pkill -INT to trigger the DB drop. Guest exam hubs redirect to /login?next= by design. At 390 the bottom-right of an exam card is the My results link, so pick blank points elsewhere.
